column1: # clues.tsv for ft_strlcpy — hints only, never answers.

strlcpy's return value is the length of SRC, independent of size. It copies at most size-1 characters and then writes a terminator inside the buffer. How many characters can you actually copy before the terminator must go down?
What happens when size is 0? There is no room even for a terminator, so you must write nothing at all -- yet what should you still return?
